title: Indian Startup HrdWyr Develops AI-Native SoCs
summary: HrdWyr is building AI-native SoCs for power management, motor control, and physical system applications.

title: Bonnell Launches 805 RX Electric Dirt Bike
summary: Bonnell launched its new 805 RX electric dirt bike, featuring 56 horsepower and an 80-mph top speed.

title: Scientists Trace Seven Stages of Meteorite Life
summary: By studying 75 fallen meteorites, scientists identified the seven stages a space rock undergoes entering Earth's atmosphere.

title: U.S. Army Plans Microreactors at Five Bases
summary: The U.S. Army awarded over $2.2 billion in contracts to build nuclear microreactors at five bases.

title: Launch Site Progress Ahead of Starship East Coast Debut
summary: SpaceX is making facility progress at its launch site in Florida ahead of upcoming Starship flights.

title: Runtime-Editable Behavior System for Humanoid Robots
summary: Researchers present a robot-local, runtime-editable behavior authoring system that enables fast creation and adaptation of loco-manipulation behaviors on humanoid robots.

title: Visko Launches Orbis Live Model
summary: Visko launched its Orbis model that streams 4K video at 24 frames per second and closed a pre-seed funding round.

title: Evaluating Temporal Robustness in Imitation Learning
summary: A study compares an expert and an imitation learning policy across task execution speeds in a dexterous parcel stowing task.

title: Vision-Based Formation Control for UAVs
summary: A vision-based cooperative framework enables follower UAVs to track and maintain formation with a leader UAV in GPS-degraded environments.

title: Blackbox Modeling of Grid-Connected Inverters
summary: A new sequence domain structure represents the dynamic behavior of commercial grid-connected converters in asymmetrical power grid conditions.

title: Evaluating Multimodal LLMs for Drone Control
summary: A new benchmark and architecture evaluates multimodal large language models as generalist agents for drone control tasks.

title: Autonomous Robotic Aquatic Bridging via Swarms
summary: Researchers demonstrate a swarm-capable autonomous aquatic bridging system using distributed swarm control without inter-agent communication or GPS.

title: Unified ROS 2 Architecture for Outdoor Robots
summary: A unified ROS 2 architecture combines coverage planning, RTK-GNSS localization, and navigation to achieve reliable autonomous outdoor coverage missions.

title: Satellite Swarms for Direct-to-Cell Networks
summary: This work investigates 2D distributed satellite swarm configurations for direct-to-cell applications to exploit increased spatial resolution from large distributed apertures.

title: Cheshire Viaduct Joint Replacement and Upgrade Begins
summary: Work has started on a 27 million pound vital upgrade including joint replacement for the Thelwall Viaduct on the M6.

title: Cat-Clawed Drone Lands on Vertical Ice Walls
summary: Researchers have developed a quadcopter capable of landing on near-vertical ice walls for environmental science applications.

title: U.S. Navy Funds Phase II for UAV Composites
summary: The U.S. Navy funded a Phase II program including thirty months of R&D for embedded-power UAV composites.

title: John Deere Launches AI Tool for Farm Data
summary: John Deere introduced JD, an AI tool that converts historical farm data into actionable insights for farmers.

title: CollPlant to Acquire LightSolver in Photonic Deal
summary: CollPlant is acquiring LightSolver, whose laser-based LPU targets optimization and computational workloads.

title: Lewes Rail Line Reopened After Cleanup
summary: Network Rail completed derailment cleanup and track renewal, allowing train services between Lewes and Haywards Heath to resume.

title: SiMa.ai and ARK Electronics Partner for Drones
summary: The companies are offering Modalix MLSoC bundles aimed at commercial, industrial, agriculture, and defense drone applications.

title: Anyon and KMT Partner on Quantum Computing
summary: KMT will provide integration and support as Anyon develops superconducting systems of 72 qubits and larger.

title: Advancing CFET Device Roadmap with Novel Integration Modules
summary: Pioneering work develops critical CFET modules including an improved backside contact module and a novel gate stack for threshold voltage tuning.

title: US Army to Install Nuclear Micro-Reactors
summary: The US Army authorized building up to 20 nuclear micro-reactors on domestic military bases to supply reliable power.

title: Karst Collapse Risk Assessment for Urban Metro Engineering
summary: Researchers propose an integrated framework combining geological characterization and hydrodynamic simulation to assess karst collapse risks in urban metro engineering.

title: Porous Liquid Crystal Elastomers for Tunable Acoustic Properties
summary: Researchers developed a porous liquid crystal elastomer platform enabling wide-range, reversible acoustic tuning via thermal-driven pore reconfiguration.

title: Long-Range Modulation of Pt Sites in MOFs Enhances H2O2 Activation
summary: Engineers designed Pt@UiO-66-X nanozymes to demonstrate how ligand electronegativity controls catalytic performance for pesticide detection.

title: Back-Analysis Method for Shear Strength Parameters of Double-Layered Slopes
summary: A new upper-bound back-analysis method improves shear strength parameter determination for double-layered slopes and controls inversion dispersion.

title: Passive Suppression of Gradual Opening in Wave Rotor Combustors
summary: An unpartitioned inlet duct design improves fuel-air mixing and suppresses interface distortion in wave rotor combustors.

title: Limit-State Capacity Sampling and Seismic Damage-State Distributions
summary: A unified probabilistic framework evaluates multi-limit-state capacity sampling models and their bias effects on seismic damage-state distributions.
